\begin{exercise} \end{exercise} 1. ch6:6-22

Let $(M,g)$ be a connected Riemannian manifold with boundary. Prove that $(M, d_g)$ is a complete metric space if and only if the following condition holds: for every geodesic $\gamma : [0,b) \to M$ that cannot be extended to a geodesic on any interval $[0,b')$ with $b' > b$, $\gamma (t)$ converges to a point of $\partial M$ as $t \nearrow b$. \end{exercise}

\begin{exercise} \end{exercise}[Characterization of metric isometry]
